payload.text: A single thick card slid quickly off a walnut deck with a soft paper whisper and a tiny brass clip tick. Dry, close, no reverb, one-shot.

payload.text: A heavy card thrown fast through the air: short bright whoosh rising then fading, with a faint brass metallic shimmer in the tail. Dry, one-shot.

payload.text: A thick brass-edged card slapping flat onto a polished walnut tabletop: solid wooden thud with a short metallic ring. Dry, close, one-shot.

headers.access-control-allow-methods: POST, PATCH, OPTIONS, DELETE, GET, PUT

payload.text: Two heavy brass dice tumbling and clattering across a polished walnut table, bouncing several times and slowing down. Metallic clicks and wooden knocks. Dry, one-shot.

headers.access-control-allow-methods: POST, PATCH, OPTIONS, DELETE, GET, PUT

payload.text: A brass die rocking to a stop on a walnut table: two or three fast decaying wobble clicks, then a final small settling tick and silence. Dry, one-shot.

payload.text: A soft continuous magical hum with a faint crackling shimmer, like a glowing amber finger drawing on glass. Steady, warm, airy, no melody, no pitch movement, seamless loop.

payload.text: A magical sigil being completed: bright rising shimmer, a warm resonant brass-bell chime burst, then a glittering airy tail fading out. Arcane, golden, one-shot.

headers.access-control-allow-methods: POST, PATCH, OPTIONS, DELETE, GET, PUT

payload.text: A failed spell: a weak crackling spark that sputters, a short descending fizz and a dull little pop. Small, deflating, one-shot.

payload.text: A brass steam valve releasing a burst of pressurised steam: sharp hiss that peaks fast then decays, with a faint metallic pipe resonance. Dry, one-shot.

payload.text: A heavy brass gear locking into place with a single solid metallic clank, a short ratchet click before it and a brief ring after. Dry, one-shot.

payload.text: A heavy oak door with iron hinges and a brass clockwork latch: latch clicks, the door groans open slowly with a low creak and a soft thump at the end. One-shot.

payload.text: A tiny crisp brass mechanical tick, like a clockwork escapement click. Very short, dry, quiet, one-shot interface sound.

payload.text: A heavy blow on a brass automaton: dull metallic clang with a rattle of loose gears and a short ringing decay. Dry, one-shot.

payload.text: A brass clockwork automaton breaking down: a burst of grinding gears, a spring snapping, a falling cascade of metal parts clattering, a final winding-down whir and a last clink. One-shot.

headers.access-control-allow-methods: POST, PATCH, OPTIONS, DELETE, GET, PUT

payload.text: A folding walnut table with brass hinges opening out: smooth wooden creak, hinge clicks, latches snapping into place, ending with a solid soft thump. One-shot.

payload.text: A warm bright reward chime: three quick ascending notes on a small brass music-box and glockenspiel, golden shimmer tail. Pleasant, short, one-shot.

payload.text: A somber defeat sting: low brass drone and a slow descending minor chime phrase, a clockwork mechanism winding down to a stop, then quiet. One-shot.

payload.text: A triumphant victory sting: a short rising fanfare of warm brass and bells resolving to a bright major chord with a golden shimmering tail. One-shot.

payload.text: A small brass coin or cog picked up: a bright quick metallic jingle of two tiny clinks. Short, light, dry, one-shot.

payload.text: A protective ward raising: a resonant metallic shield-up chime with a short airy swell and a solid ringing brass tone fading out. One-shot.
